company.name: Fieldguide
company.shortDescription: Agentic AI for Audit and Advisory.
company.description: Fieldguide is a vertical AI company offering an end-to-end, agentic AI platform for audit and advisory firms. The company helps firms increase margins, win new business, and build stronger client relationships. Fieldguide is backed by leading venture capital funds, including Bessemer Venture Partners, 8VC, Floodgate, Y Combinator, Justin Kan (Twitch/justin.tv), Elad Gil, Qasar Younis (Applied Intuition), Tracy Young (PlanGrid) & more.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based platform for managing and automating audit and advisory engagements, combining engagement workflows, AI capabilities, document handling, reporting, requests, and client collaboration.
productsAndServices.name: Fieldguide AI Platform

productsAndServices.description: AI capabilities and domain-specific agents that assist audit and advisory practitioners with engagement tasks, including procedure drafting and workflow automation.
productsAndServices.name: Fieldguide AI

productsAndServices.description: Engagement management software that coordinates the lifecycle of audit and advisory work from scoping and testing through completion and final reporting.
productsAndServices.name: Full Engagement Management

productsAndServices.description: A system for creating, sending, tracking, and managing client information requests through automated workflows.
productsAndServices.name: Request Management

productsAndServices.description: Workpaper and evidence management software that associates documents with controls and supports collaboration without manual file tracking.
productsAndServices.name: Document Management

productsAndServices.description: Reporting software that uses engagement data to generate final reports and provide performance insights for audit and advisory teams.
productsAndServices.name: Reporting Automation
